findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements. 

On arrival the chemical used for wiping down the counters and food contact items is a disinfectant not intended for food contact items (per its label). The chemicals were discussed with the PIC and multiple options available in the snack bar discussed. None of these are intended for food contact surfaces. Education was discussed and the PIC was made aware of what to look for when choosing a sanitizer. A spray bottle was made from the dispenser in the other room and it is intended for food contact surfaces. This chemical is Quat based, which matches the test strips available and the previous inspections. The violation is considered corrected at this time.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.14: A sign or poster that notifies FOOD EMPLOYEES to wash their hands shall be provided at all HANDWASHING SINKS used by FOOD EMPLOYEES and shall be clearly visible to FOOD EMPLOYEES. 

On arrival, no signage was available at the hand washing sink to indicate/designate that it was for hand washing. Signage was provided to correct the violation.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, no test strips are available for use at the facility. Test strips were acquired during this inspection to correct the violation.
